question: An infinite straight wire carries a uniform linear charge density $λ$. A short electric dipole with dipole moment $\vec{p}$ is placed at a perpendicular distance $r$ from the wire. The dipole moment $\vec{p}$ is aligned radially outwards from the wire. By analyzing the interaction between the non-uniform field of the wire and the dipole, determine how the magnitude of the net force $F$ on the dipole varies with the distance $r$.
